item.title: Multimodal Diffusion Language Models for Thinking-Aware Editing and Generation
item.description:
📝 Environment Setup First, start with a torch environment with torch 2. MMaDA-Parallel-A is trained with tokenizer Amused-VQ, and MMaDA-Parallel-M is trained with tokenizer Magvitv2. Parallel Gen with MMaDA-Parallel-M cd MMaDA-Parallel-M python inference.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/tyfeld/MMaDA-Parallel
